name: Siren & Lucia's Room
body:
The chronicler's suite. Library Tower proximity gives Siren natural light through tall windows for her writing. One wall lined with notebooks and recording equipment, the other with Lucia's mechanical tools and riding gear — recording alcove and bike storage sharing space with the scent of ink-stained pages and grease-marked wrenches. WITNESS MEETS WILD.

A corkboard maps Siren's interview schedule alongside Lucia's garage shifts. The window seat holds both notebooks and motorcycle manuals.

AND ON A SMALL SHELF: the silver magpie pendant Bryn crafted, Siren's sister's initials hidden in the wing. Her older sister, who told their conservative old-guard Fairbrooks parents I TALKED HIM INTO IT, PUNISH ONLY ME when they were caught crossdressing — who took the fall for both of them and was sent to St. Jonah's so Siren could stay free. THOSE INITIALS ARE THE QUIETEST, FIERCEST THING IN THE ROOM.

Magpie is Siren's nickname and her spirit animal. Lucia is the Playful Lioness, and she talks the whole way through.
